tests.description: Valid, invalid and boundary requests match the admitted CapabilityDefinition request schema.
Every terminal response carries exactly one admitted result or error shape.
Retries obey the declared idempotency scope and reject one key with a different request digest.
The Provider rejects any mismatch in Tenant, ClientApplication, Principal context, WorkOrder, ProviderRevision, Attempt, fencing token, request digest, policy, budget, permissions or staging claims.
A stale fencing token cannot mutate state and attempt-local Event sequence remains contiguous and idempotent.
Oversized encoded request bodies are rejected with 413 before JSON parsing or Provider work begins.
Observed side effects do not exceed the CapabilityDefinition classification or approved policy.
Timeout, cancellation and status-query behavior exactly follows the CapabilityDefinition declarations.
Input and output Artifacts satisfy declared roles, media types, digests and staging rules.
The Provider cannot exceed approved permissions, budget or gateway requirements.
